dataBasis: per 100 g edible portion; liquids are approximated per 100 ml
sourceNote: Expanded offline starter dataset for fitness tracking. Ingredient values are generic estimates per 100 g edible portion (liquids are approximated per 100 ml). Newly added mixed Indian dishes are representative recipe estimates, not universal laboratory values; oil, ingredients, brand, preparation and serving sizes change nutrition significantly. The dataset is not a direct official IFCT or USDA export. For product labels use the package label; before public release verify raw ingredients against ICMR-NIN Indian Food Composition Tables (IFCT 2017), USDA FoodData Central, or an appropriate documented recipe database.
